name: Automatically rotate slides
description: Home hero, product gallery and related products. Turn off to stop automatic rotation; visitor controls still work.

name: Slide duration (milliseconds)
description: Home hero and product gallery. 2000 = 2 seconds, 5000 = 5 seconds. Blank keeps that section default. Between 2000 and 20000.

name: Image or 3D display
description: Shop/collection hero and product gallery: image or 3d. Uploaded section images take priority in heroes. Product gallery image hides the 3D panel. Ingredient sections also accept image.
